column1: # Usage-based floor-prune provenance for the 3D map corpus.
# usage-pruned with mapgen -demos against the hub games listed here. A map
# may list several modes (one line each); all its lines' games feed one prune.
# Selection (regenerated 2026-10-27): the newest games on the local corpus,
# 4on4 first, then 2on2, then 1on1, up to ~10 4on4 / 20 2on2 / 40 1on1 of
# coverage. Maps whose local corpus was too thin for that (phantoma, which
# has no provisioned BSP, plus shifter, stronghold, toxicity) keep their
# earlier 2026-06/07 prune and lines. Floors under a liquid surface are never
# pruned (swimmers never touch the pool bottom).
